# Publish Veil 0.13.0

Publish from PR #189’s existing branch, `release/0.13.0-rc.0`. The branch name
retains the RC suffix so the existing PR stays open; all ten package versions
and internal peer floors are stable `0.13.0`. Changesets prerelease mode has
ended. Release notes are in [`0.13.0.md`](./0.13.0.md).

## Before publication

Use the prepared worktree:

```sh
cd /Users/privacydaddy/.codex/worktrees/freezelist-algorithm/aleo-viem
```

Run `git fetch origin`, confirm the clean checkout matches the pushed PR head,
and check authentication with `npm whoami` and `gh auth status`. Review the
known limitations in the release notes. The versions have already been
calculated; do not run `version-packages` again before this release.

Run these checks before obtaining a fresh npm OTP:

```sh
pnpm install --frozen-lockfile &&
pnpm build &&
node --input-type=module <<'JS'
import assert from 'node:assert/strict'
import { existsSync, readFileSync, readdirSync } from 'node:fs'
const names = JSON.parse(readFileSync('.changeset/config.json', 'utf8')).fixed[0]
const packages = readdirSync('packages').map(dir =>
  JSON.parse(readFileSync(`packages/${dir}/package.json`, 'utf8')))
assert.equal(names.length, 10)
assert.equal(existsSync('.changeset/pre.json'), false)
for (const name of names) {
  const pkg = packages.find(pkg => pkg.name === name)
  assert.equal(pkg?.version, '0.13.0', name)
  assert.notEqual(pkg.private, true, name)
}
console.log('All ten packages are stable 0.13.0; prerelease mode is off.')
JS
```

## Publish npm packages and the GitHub release

Replace `123456` with a fresh npm OTP. The npm command explicitly selects
`latest`. Each step stops if the preceding step fails. The tag push selects
only this release’s overall and package tags.

```sh
test "$(git branch --show-current)" = 'release/0.13.0-rc.0' &&
test -z "$(git status --porcelain)" &&
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$(git rev-parse origin/release/0.13.0-rc.0)" &&
test ! -e .changeset/pre.json &&
pnpm --filter './packages/*' -r publish --tag latest --access public \
  --publish-branch release/0.13.0-rc.0 --otp=123456 &&
pnpm exec changeset tag &&
git tag -a v0.13.0 -m 'Veil 0.13.0' &&
git push origin 'refs/tags/*0.13.0:refs/tags/*0.13.0' &&
gh release create v0.13.0 --repo ProvableHQ/veil --verify-tag \
  --latest --title 'Veil 0.13.0' \
  --notes-file .github/releases/0.13.0.md
```

The publish command moves npm’s `latest` tag to `0.13.0` for all ten packages.
The existing `rc` tags and published `v0.13.0-rc.0` release remain intact.
The remaining commands create the package tags and stable GitHub release.
The root `pnpm release` script rebuilds before publishing, which can consume
the OTP’s validity window; use the explicit command above after the build checks.

If npm reports an expired OTP or a partial publish, retry only:

```sh
pnpm --filter './packages/*' -r publish --tag latest --access public \
  --publish-branch release/0.13.0-rc.0 --otp=NEW_CODE
```

Recursive pnpm publication skips versions already published. Retry from the
same commit without changing versions or moving tags. Complete the Git/GitHub
steps after all packages succeed. If a later step fails, resume at that step
without recreating an existing tag.

## Verify publication

Registry propagation may take a few minutes. Every package must report
`latest: 0.13.0` and retain `rc: 0.13.0-rc.0`:

```sh
node --input-type=module <<'JS'
import assert from 'node:assert/strict'
import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs'
const names = JSON.parse(readFileSync('.changeset/config.json', 'utf8')).fixed[0]
for (const name of names) {
  const response = await fetch(`https://registry.npmjs.org/${name.replace('/', '%2f')}`)
  assert.equal(response.status, 200, name)
  const metadata = await response.json()
  console.log(name, metadata['dist-tags'])
  assert.equal(metadata['dist-tags'].latest, '0.13.0', name)
  assert.equal(metadata['dist-tags'].rc, '0.13.0-rc.0', name)
  assert.ok(metadata.versions['0.13.0'], name)
}
JS
gh release view v0.13.0 --repo ProvableHQ/veil
```
